hypothesis: Falling mining capacity may accompany financial pressure and inventory sales by miners. A short BTC future tests this conjecture; hashrate is not a direct measure of selling, and weather, regulation or random block arrivals can cause contraction without selling pressure.
distinctness: Mining supply/capital expenditure mechanism, distinct input from native transfers N12, leverage/open interest N11 and option skew N13. Simple moving-average operators are not themselves a new family. Final independent economic distinctness remains required; only one mining family can count across variants.

source.units: BTC TH/s estimated from difficulty and block production; retain source decimal string.
source.limits: One public GET, page_size=10000, maximum 2 MB response. Preserve any HTTP error; no paid service, alternate metric or unregistered fallback.
source.historicalAvailability: Current response does not prove historical publication/vintages. Treat D as day start, feature end D+24h, wait another 48h, then enter next H1 open. This conservative delay is an exploratory assumption, not proof of original availability.

rule.condition: Arithmetic mean of the latest 7 consecutive daily HashRate values is strictly less than arithmetic mean of latest 30 consecutive values, both ending at D. Equality does not trigger. No price filter.
rule.missing: Require all 30 consecutive positive finite daily values. No interpolation, duplicate dates or replacement series.
rule.prospective: Bind values/vintages to receipts; each input must have been received between its day end and its own D+72h deadline. Prospective implementation/feed still unproven.

execution: Reuse frozen USD-M executor v4 and base/stress fees, slippage and funding rules. Prices from BTC development only; no short option positions or financial orders. The5ers contract/cost equivalence unproven.
selection: No real HashRate, trigger count or N14 performance read before this registration. Freeze inputs, rule, code and tests before sample. DEV2022-2024 only. Fewer than100 triggers stops without PnL; any financial gate failure stops before2025/2026. No reversal, threshold tuning, exposure reduction or additional asset after seeing results.
